translations.web: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.
translations.bsb: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
translations.kjv: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.
translations.asv: O Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name cometh of thy hand, and is all thine own.
